title: PodBooth MiniMax H3 Ref2VA
description: RunPod Serverless worker for MiniMax Hailuo H3 reference-to-video (Ref2VA). Up to 9 images / 3 videos / 3 audio / 12 mixed. Native stereo audio. Sibling of the I2V/FL2VA worker — same Japan volume, different DiT. Weights live on a network volume. Pin the endpoint to AP-JP-1.
